description: Canonical MCP-server skill pack — each skill wraps a Model Context Protocol server.

agentdb-memory.description: Self-learning vector memory via AgentDB MCP — pattern storage, semantic search, Reflexion, causal graphs, and skill library.

brave-search.description: Web search via Brave Search MCP — web, local, image, video, news results with AI summaries.

comfyui.description: ComfyUI image generation via MCP — execute workflows, generate images, manage models, control VRAM.

exa-search.description: AI-powered web search via Exa MCP — semantic search, code search, company research, content crawling.

gmail.description: Gmail integration via MCP — search, read, send, label, draft, forward, autoreply, bulk operations.

google-sheets.description: Google Sheets integration via MCP — read, write, create, format spreadsheets programmatically.

google-calendar.description: Google Calendar integration via MCP — create, update, list events, check availability, manage calendars.

google-tasks.description: Google Tasks integration via MCP — create, list, complete, organize tasks and task lists.

clickup.description: ClickUp project management via MCP — tasks, sprints, comments, docs, time tracking with natural language.

reddit.description: Reddit integration via MCP — search posts, read threads, monitor subreddits, analyze discussions.

jina-reader.description: Web content extraction via Jina Reader MCP — convert any URL to clean markdown, extract structured data.

context7.description: Context7 documentation search via MCP — search up-to-date library docs, API references, code examples.

git-mcp.description: Git version control via MCP — clone, commit, branch, merge, diff, stash, cherry-pick, and worktree operations.

gitlab.description: GitLab integration via MCP — projects, merge requests, issues, pipelines, wiki, releases, milestones.

notion.description: Notion workspace integration via MCP — pages, databases, blocks, search, and content management.

obsidian.description: Obsidian vault management via MCP — read, write, search, edit notes, tags, and frontmatter.
